AI can draft a hundred posts.
You still have to read every one.
So pick the rhythm you can approve.
For one founder, a realistic week looks like this.
Three posts on your main social channel.
Two repurposed posts on a second channel, if you want one.
One blog article, drafted by Claude from your notes.
And one newsletter, which arrives in lesson five.
That's roughly twenty-five to thirty pieces a month, and about forty-five minutes of review each week, once the system runs.
If that feels like a lot, start smaller: one channel and the blog.
Consistency beats volume, because a calendar you keep for thirty days does more than one you abandon in week two.
Next, turn the rhythm into a sheet.
